cases.claim: “Life with hidradenitis suppurativa. It’s a lot about bandages. …But they can’t hide everything.” | “Then I started Bimzelx. I’m starting to feel like… I’m back.” | “Bimzelx can deliver transformative relief of HS symptoms.” | “I’m back to making a difference.” | “Give yourself a chance to say … I’m back.”
cases.context: Patient unwraps bandages, wears sleeveless clothes, dances, yoga, hugs friend; tear at start → cheerful at end. DLQI not adequately content-valid in moderate-to-severe HS. W&P: suicidal ideation and behavior. SUPER: “Results may vary.”
cases.rationale: Suggests transformative improvement in emotional/social functioning (HRQoL) not demonstrated.
cases.check: Judge: emotional/social transformation narratives ('I'm back', melancholy→socially active) where PI has no validated HRQoL support; heightened concern if W&P on suicidal ideation.
